descriptionChirho: To strike or beat someone physically, whether in violence, punishment, or assault; encompasses all active voice inflections including participles and infinitives (Mt 24:49; 27:30; Mk 15:19; Lk 6:29; 12:45; 18:13; 22:64; 23:48; Acts 18:17; 21:32; 23:2-3; 1 Cor 8:12).
To be struck or beaten, the passive counterpart of the active sense (Acts 23:3).
